A religious cult, the Eleusian Mysteries, flourished around Eleusis in ancient Greece. It sprang from an agrarian fertility cult which originated around 600BC. Initiation into  the cult required the newcomer to undergo a series of trials. In this program, we re-enact one such trial, in which the neophyte's mental ability is tested. You are handed a cube, fashioned of a clear, amber-Like solid. You are told that the cube contains three gems which are invisible to the naked eye. You have to concentrate your mental energy beam on a particular part of the cube, and then deduce - if your mental energy beam emerges or not from the opposite side - where the three gems are located. You are told how many mental energy rays you have left, and are asked to say which face of the cube you will concentrate on (entering a four if you think where the gems are Located). The player continues, entering beams until he or she is
confident regarding the gems' locations. If all goes well you will have the skills to enter into the mystery yourself!

216576.overview:
Cross Bomber is a game that was developed and released on several home computers, including the Commodore 64. It was developed by Fabrizio Caruso and released into the public domain on November 4, 2021.

Game description:

The game's goal is to destroy all buildings so that you can land on an empty road. The game is a clone of Air Attack (aka Blitz) game that was first developed on the Commodore Pet. The game is controlled by the single fire button (first joystick button for targets with joystick input and space key for targets with keyboard input). Your score depends on the number of building destroyed, the level reached and how fast you complete each single level. The game has 8 levels and it ends after the eighth level.

216577.overview: Cross-Tracks is a board game for 1 player. It was developed by Larry Hatch and published as a type-in game in the book "25 Advanced Games for the Commodore 64" in 1984.

216589.overview:
A geography educational game created by Vince Apps and released in 1984 in the book "40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64". A few years ago the Government changed the names of most of the counties in England, Wales and Scotland. Some people still call them by their old names so we have come up with this program to help you make sure you know the new names and where they are. Your computer knows where Gwent is - do you?

The computer will draw an outline map for you and give you a list of ten county names to choose from. The computer will then choose, at random, an area for you to identify. A flashing sign will indicate the area in question. Type in your answer in upper case (capitals). Tries and scores are shown on the screen. If you are wrong you can try again.

216759.overview: Code-Woord is a Dutch language 1-2 player Mastermind clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Newman College and published by Wolters Software in 1984.

216846.overview:
Closet of Mystery is a rather short text adventure for the Commodore 64, in which the goal is to escape a broom closet inside The Red Anchor (a pub) that someone locked you in.

The game was developed by Michael Cox for PunyJam#1 in 2021.

216847.overview: Cohan's Land is a German language text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Michael Nickles and published in 64'er Sonderheft 1986/04. Discover the secret of the message in the bottle. Is the treasure really there or is it just a joke? You don't have to walk around and read nice room descriptions as with INFOCOM - things really get going right away. Same with Cohan's Land. The texts are kept short, but the problems are extremely tricky. However, the parser turned out much better. The vocabulary includes about 140 words and the parser understands whole sentences. Nevertheless, the program is only about 30 Kbytes long. The story is extremely interesting: Fantasy, science fiction and nostalgia elements appear in the game.

216848.overview: Combat Zone is a text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Robert Bertoz and Andrew Smith in 1984.

217419.overview: Conway's Game of Life Simulator is a computerized version of Conway's Game of Life for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Marek Karcz and released into the public domain in 2013.

218193.overview: Chopping Mall: Santa's Rampage is a SEUCK game for 1 or 2 players (co-op). It was developed by Jeff Boyle, and was released as part of the 1991 C64 scene demo "Snow Job" by the demo group 215.

218630.overview: Cosmos 3000 is a Polish language fixed-screen shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Andrzej Ostaszczuk and published by Biuro Informatyczno Wydawnicze (BIW) in 1994.

218896.overview: Cloux is a clone of Mine Sweeper. The player can set the number of mines - from 1 to 12 and the size of the board - from 3 to 20 fields horizontally and from 3 to 25 fields vertically. The rest of the rules remain the same. After pressing the field, a number with the number of bombs in the vicinity is displayed. Hitting the bomb ends the game.

218924.overview:
Caim is a top-down action-adventure game with puzzle-solving elements for the C64. It balances action, exploration, and puzzles with an emphasis on the narrative. 

You, an unnamed player, wake up in a strange place without any recollection of how you got there. Explore the facility, avoid deadly hazards and uncover mysteries. As you learn more about the place, the world and yourself, you get ever closer to putting together all the clues and reaching the exit.

The music tracks are by unknown composers from HVSC. The story was inspired by The Talos Principle. Use the joystick in port 2 to play.

219126.overview: Shadowgate, a point and click adventure game developed by ICOM Simulations for the Apple Macintosh, was ported to many platforms. However, an official version was never released (or developed?) for the Commodore 64 (two of ICOM's other "MacVenture" games were released for the C64). This is a new port of the game, heavily based on the popular Nintendo Entertainment System version. Please check out the manual before giving it a try. Last updated 1/30/2023.

219128.overview: Cab Hustle is a new game for the C64, inspired by games such as Space Taxi, TurboRaketti, and Crazy Taxi.

219211.overview: Celtix is a miscellaneous single-player shooter for the Commodore 64. The game was developed by 59 Productions and published in Loadstar #157.

219671.overview: An updated preview from Martin Piper, the shooter was originally released in 1992 by Martin Piper and Alan Peters, and re-released with updated code by the original coder with updated music from Richard Bayliss.

219675.overview:
Commodore-Connection is a clone of the arcade game City Connection for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Emanuele Bonin and released into the public domain on February 25, 2023.

Released as part of Retro Programmers Inside's Racing Cars Game Jam.

219726.overview: Eleanor Burns and TND games is very proud to present Cipher Patrol 2 - The Pure Sword. This is a Strider inspired game that was originally made using the Shoot Em Up Construction Kit, but has been fully transformed into a proper platform action arcade action adventure with thanks to Eleanor's additional code.  The game also features a brand new front end, new score panel and atmospheric music by TND games.

219781.overview:
Czołgi (translates to Tanks) is a tank battle party game for 2 - 4 players.

3 and 4 player mode require a special adapter.

219791.overview: It's a Pong game with a big C= logo appearing in the middle of the screen and changing the route of the C= ball, making the game more funny and various compared to the original Pong game.

219814.overview: In this game, you must construct correct English words by rotating columns of letters or by rotating the bottom row before the letters reach the top level. You can get extra points if you complete the level earlier by lowering the stack of letters below the second row.

219831.overview:
Old New City is being over run by the Speccy Punks, This is a Job for Cybo-Cop, Push scroll Left with 8 Way shooting, Shoot the Speccy Punks, Save the Lady's, And pick up Point Cans, 1 Player Game.

Made with the Sideways Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software and Jon Wells, Also New V3 SEUCK Framework by Richard Bayliss.

219832.overview: Control falling blocks. Adjacent blocks with same color are cancelled. Get points for every filled line. A Full screen color matching puzzle game from Josip Kalebic. Just match two blocks of the same color and get some good chains.

219833.overview: In the far future, the Federation of Planets needs brave space pilots to patrol the spaceways of the Galaxy. And among these interstellar peacekeepers, few are as brave as Captain Ishtar of Mars...

220119.overview:
One of two games released by Duckworth Home Computing named Car Dodge, this one is by Richard Franklin and was released in the book, "CBM 64 Programs - Volume 1"

Car is a racing game on a track the shape of which looks similar to a rifle, thus incorporating the required bends to make the game interesting. Car differs from the usual racing game because it requires as near as possible the actual driving skills one would learn in a 'real car'. The player must use his judgement when accelerating and changing through the gears. The driving novice is almost guaranteed to stall or over rev the engine causing a blow out.

241884.overview: Cracky is a simple platform game in which the player has to collect all the stars before the time runs out. Whilst most of the platforms are solid, some of them can only be passed through once, and the player can't jump, so a bit of strategy is required to collect all the stars. After a level is cleared, another one with more enemies and stars follows. There are two ways with which lives can be lost; coming into contact with an enemy or running out of time. Once every one of those lives are gone, the game will be over.

271940.overview:
CommodoRex is yet another version of T-Rex, a popular runner that you can play when your Chrome web browser is disconnected from the internet. And doing exactly the opposite was the purpose of this project: to play T-Rex when your C64 is online! With 64NIC+ or WiC64 cartridges attached to your C64 this is possible! But, in case you don't have these cartridges, you still can enjoy playing offline and save your hi-scores to disk or tape. 

Available on ZZAP! 64 Micro Action Issue #10's cover disk, on the Double Dino compilation cartridge by Bobr Games and as a digital download.

294883.overview:
Back in the 1980s, when not all cars looked the same, Japanese automaker Honda made a name for itself with the CRX model, a sleek coupe with a lot of bang under the hood. In this racing game called " CRX Race " you drive that cult car through a total of three different levels . In general, it is important to avoid collisions, from level 2 time and speed also play a role. Level 1 is a bird's eye view of the track, Level 2 is a side view and Level 3 is a rear view of the CRX. Only those who master the last stretch to the finish have made it through the game. 
 

    You can only have 10 collisions with the edge of the road per level before the vehicle gives up the ghost, which can be read on the damage bar .
    From level 2 you also have to keep an eye on the time counter and possibly step on the gas.
    The finish bar shows how far away the target is.
    A CRX can only be bought twice per game, which corresponds to the usual three "lives".

417563.overview: A version of Concentration for one to two players, made by Peter Ragsdale and released in 1982. It is a brain\memory game where you try to find matching patterns. It was released in the Canadian exclusive Commodore 64 Program Pack and later in CBM Public Domain - English I.

417866.overview: An arcade collect-em up game from Charles Grey, released in the Minigame Competition 2009 - 1K Category.

417877.overview: Roll dice to fill your four-part try with one of each card: Ace, King, Queen and Jack, if you can. A card game with dice from Payton Byrd.

417936.overview: A single player arcade collect'em up by Georg Rottensteiner and released to PD for the 20 Zeilen BASIC Compo in 2008.

417970.overview: A PD puzzle release from Arne Puszelski & Nico van der Zijden in 2007.

417985.overview:
Oh no! Chef is out of ingredients so it's time to venture into the restaurant's dungeon to restock the larder with delicious monsters. Chef Quest is a tiny, action-oriented RPG of culinary delights.

Chef Quest was my entry for the RESET 64 4kb Competition (2018). Despite appearances and tiny file size there's a bit of depth to how the game works (which confused most people, and is a good lesson that hopefully I learn one day). It is highly recommended you read the instructions first before playing.

418041.overview: A puzzle game from Charles Grey where you need to match the top with the bottom to score.

418362.overview:
Croqueur (French for Crunchy)  is a French language arcade collect 'em up game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Christian Planckaert and published in Hebdogiciel N°118 (17.01.1986) + N°119 (24.01.1986).

The game has some resemblance to the early 1980s C64 game, Jawbreaker.

Eat all the sweets, but avoid the baddies.

418367.overview:
Crimp: The Battle is a two player only vs shooter for the Commodore 64. It's one of those games where the first person who reaches a set score is the winner.

The game was developed by Robert Pätzmann, Hildebrand Mueller, and Ari-Pekka Paljakka and published both into the public domain, but also as part of  GO64! 2005/01.

418852.overview: Chopper Attack Three: Raid on Pearl Harbour is a single player shooter in which you play a Japanese pilot involved in the attack on Pearl Harbor during the second world war. The game was developed by the SEUCK Design Group and released into the public domain in 1989.

419241.overview: Six Games in a Crane aka Crane Driver is a collection of six educational mini games for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published by Alexander Leslie Software in 1984.

419359.overview: Chief Tomahawk (also known as Chief Tomahawk's Games) is a collection of puzzle Mini games for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Barbara H. Schulak and published in 1989 as part of Loadstar #65.

421100.overview: "Chaluul's Curse" is a C64 port of a PC adventure that was on the cover CD of issue 11/95 of the German computer games magazine "PC Spiel".

424144.overview: Cave of the Reaper is a 1987 text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Steve Shelton and published in Loadstar #035.

424219.overview:
The colossal nightmare beast has descended onto earth. Your only chance is your acid suit and your electric zapper. Couragely you jump into its mouth and make for its eyes and heart. Destroy all three and return to the mouth to exit!
This is a C64 game, so behold the retro goodness! Control is via Joystick in Port 2. Press fire to start game. Move and fire about. Press M to display the map.

425113.overview: Circus Fun - a cancelled Circus Charlie clone intended for Alligata Software on the Commodore 64. The game consists of controlling a clown on top of a lion who has to jump through hoops of fire. There are money bags, which you would think are collectable, but these actually kill you if you collide with them.

425157.overview: An arcade style game created by Jens Thomsen and published in the book "Still Programming the Commodore 64", by the same. The full version was released in 2020.

425239.overview: Caissa a 1-player keyboard controlled German language chess game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Friedhelm Wrensch and published by Dynamics Marketing in 1984.

425248.overview: Crazy Car is a 1-2 co-operative shooter that tries to resemble a game like Spy Hunter. It was developed by Carlo Santagostino using Chris Yates/Sensible Software's Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit and published by Systems Editoriale in 1989.

425255.overview: A single player 3D shooter created by Marcel Smuz, Sisonkham P and Rodney Balai and it was published in 64'er Sonderheft 90 in 1992. Since this features real 3D environments it runs incredibly slowly on stock hardware. This game truly benefits from emulation, it is highly recommended to increase your CPU speed by several hundred percent. it was created with the C64 3D Construction Kit. While the game was originally all in German, there is an English translation available.

425275.overview: An avoid it game from the wonderfully named Funkenstört group and released in Zzap!64 Micro Action #05 in 2021. In it you must run around the outside of the screen picking up diamonds while avoiding the ever-multiplying balls. Not even one can touch you or the game ends.

425389.overview: Being a chef is the busiest work. Keep all the items in the air without dropping them. Keep the food away from the mice and the cat. A catch'it game from Oxvalley and released as Public Domain in 2023. It is an unofficial conversion of the 1981's Nintendo Game & Watch handheld. Ported to the C64 in 1983 by unknown, revised by Oxvalley in 2023.

425420.overview: Created for Reset64 4kb 'Craptastic' Game Compo 2020, this is a dueling shooter created by Kamil Wolnikowski for two players only.

425424.overview:
Written by Josip Retro Bits for the BASIC 10Liner Contest 2023.
Your ship is trapped inside a large cave on an unknown planet.
You need to escape from the cave while the alien ship is blocking your way. 
There is not much time left until the bomb that you set up goes off!

425448.overview: This or that, places or people. Define your question set and see how many questions you can answer before you answer incorrectly.  Written in just 4k in July 2020.

425466.overview: A maze game created by Barry Hart in released to PD at the 2022 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. you enter a maze with a mission: to catch all 22 loose 22's that have escaped from Numberland. If you can catch all of them before your limited 222 moves run out, you win! The catch is, you cannot double back on where you have walked in the past.

425488.overview: An arcade game from Michael Cooper that was released for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition and published in Reset Magazine. Your job, as a custom agent is to sort the arriving ship passengers between well and unwell. The yellow scanner will turn green or red and you must guide the passenger to the correct gate by selecting it. Get it wrong and we will have to SHUT THINGS DOWN!!

425797.overview: Cratunnel is a new game for the Commodore C64 computer, developed by Iceout. The game is only 512 bytes in size. It is an avoid it game where you guide your snake on the right side of the screen to avoid the oncoming asterisks. Survive as long as you can under the onslaught of "stars".

442149.overview: A 1993 computerized Blackjack game for up to 7 players for the Commodore 64. It was developed by John M. Campbell and published in Loadstar #107.

442154.overview: Not to be confused with the game of the same name from Markt & Technik, Carcrash is a 2002 miscellaneous German racing game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Stefan Gutsch and published by Protovision PD, and released at Visionparty 2002.

444259.overview:
After your last trade of corefakeium crystals went sideways (your business associates decided to rat you out to the authorities to keep the merchandise, money, and the bounty), you are once again trying to escape from the evil galactic empire (is there such a thing as a decent galactic empire?). Luckily, your chances are great; you are only at the core of the main galactic hub space station, where all the empire's fleet is stationed.

Battle your way out through eight stages in a constant race forward – you have not been voted the "Best-looking blockade runner of the interior systems" for the last three years to be caught by the authorities. Collect additional lives and credits (score) on the way out.

Control is with a joystick in port two – just move and fire, no brains required. The space bar will pause the game, and 'Stop' returns you to the main menu.

Various cheats are available that can be activated during gameplay, but using them will prevent you from getting a high score:

-    T: Trainer mode grants infinite lives.
-    L: Gives you another life.
-    R: Restarts the current level.
-    S: Skips the current level.
-    H: Slows the game to half speed. 

The game has been designed for and tested with PAL on various C64 and C64 emulators (e.g. TheC64) your NTSC mileage will vary.

444282.overview:
"The Chaos Engine is a top-down run and gun video game developed by The Bitmap Brothers and originally published by Renegade Software in March 1993.This new release for C64 is similarly set in a steampunk Victorian age in which one or two players must battle the hostile creations of the eponymous Chaos Engine across four landscapes and ultimately defeat it and its deranged inventor". 
 
The demo is a bit rough — letting players walk out of bounds, for instance — and only covers the first stage of the game and the demo ends just before the level 1 exit gate.

444283.overview: Jump from platform to platform and collect the colors Red, Green, Blue, Yellow and Purple to score points. The more you collect on each platform, the more points you score. The amount of colors you pick up will be multiplied with the number listed on the score bar. When you have collected all the 5 different colors, this number will rise. Avoid the Grey plattforms, landing on these plattforms could be lethal as they are broken. If you fall to the ground your car will explode

446007.overview:
Cats 'n Critters introduces you to the whimsical world of feline freinds Maple and Button, who have been unwittingly thrown into a perilous quest to rid their garden of menacing critters that have invaded their home.

Hedgehogs with razor sharp quills,  swooping hawks and mischievous spiders now roam their once peaceful home, threatening the delicate balance of their garden. 

But these  creatures are not the only visitors...mysterious butterflies have also descended upon the garden, shimmering hues of azure, ruby and amethyst, and each one carrying their own magical secret - the power to grant blessings....and curses!

Join Maple and Button as they accept their roles as guardians of the garden and embark upon their quest to catch as many butterflies as possible, harnessing their magic to fend off the critters, as the fate of the garden rests on their furry shoulders!


Features

- Single player mode

- 2 player competitive mode

- Compatible with TheC64 mini/maxi

- Compatible with PAL C64 (recommended)

-- Will run under NTSC but with peculiarities with the music

446610.overview: Blind is a game made by Pinhead Games for the Commodore 64. It was made using Garry Kitchen's Gamemaker. The year of release is currently unknown.

446730.overview: Cursed Tomb is an action puzzle game that provides 64 well-design but challenging levels.

447400.overview:
Cops and Robbers: Police Subtraction is an educational math game that focuses on subtraction. Instead of typing in the answer directly, you have to type in the square that contains the correct answer. The game was developed by Debby Babicz and initially published by Commodore Educational Software (a division of Commodore Business Machines, that was based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada)

It was later released as part of Digital Marketing PD #067.

The exact year of release is not known.

447952.overview: A Sh'mup created using the sideways scrolling Shoot'em Up Construction Set by The New Dimension Games in 2024. Our Defense base on the new moon, Ceti 22 has been ransacked by alien pirates. The defense systems are no longer protecting us. Instead they are targeting us! Your mission is to guide a moon buggy through three sectors. Blast the aliens and the rogue defenses. Locate the core power, based in the underground zone inside the main base. Then of course destroy it and shut down all the rogue defenses. Rescue our people who are in danger.

448374.overview: Sort the balls in the tubes. To finish a level the tubes have to be filled to the top with only identically colored balls or be empty. Use the letter keys to pick a ball and place it into another tube. You can also put the ball back  into the same tube. When moving a ball to another tube you can only drop it on top of an equally colored ball or into an empty tube. Invalid moves are blocked and indicated by a flashing border. There is not time or retry limit. Progress is saved after solving a level.

448591.overview:
Cops and Robbers is a two-player game originally published in "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games." One player controls the cops, while the other controls the robbers. The goal for the cops is to chase and catch the robbers in the city before they escape to their hideout.

The city streets run north to south and east to west. The cops have faster cars but must obey traffic laws, allowing only forward or left turns at intersections, with no right turns or U-turns. The robbers can ignore traffic laws, giving them better maneuverability despite having slower cars.

Players can choose the speed of the game. At its fastest, it becomes a thrilling chase through the streets. Played more slowly, it becomes a game of strategy.

449056.overview:
Rev your engine - it's time to do some racing!

Try your driving skills against the meanest, leanest, sleekest road machines around. Put your Diablo to the test as you race, avoid bad-attitude cops, and put the skids on your opponents. Bet enough money and win, and you'll be able to upgrade your car...or maybe you'll just lose it all. Think you can handle the drive?

450713.overview: Vegas Roulette (also known as Carl Lockman's Vegas Roulette) is a single player roulette game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Carl M. Lockman, and released into the public domain in 1988.

451493.overview:
Commodore 64 compatible Game Cartridge that was bundled with the infamous Commodore 64 Game System. Includes the following games:

- Fiendish Freddy's Big Top O'Fun
- International Soccer
- Flimbo's Quest
- Klax

These games, with the exception of International Soccer, were previously ordinary tape-based games, but their structure and control systems (no keyboard needed) made them well-suited to the new offering. International Soccer was previously released in 1983 on cartridge for the original C64 computer.

The C64GS was essentially a cut-back console version of the original Commodore 64, and the games developed for it could also be run on the original computer, and

451590.overview:
World Wide Expressive is proud to present the classic games collection volume 2, released in 1988 which includes:

◉ Donkey Kong
◉ Crystals of Zong
◉ Exterminator
◉ Pole Position

452163.overview: Cubic Tic Tac Toe is a 1-2 player  computerized version of the board game Cubic (known better in most computerized versions as 3D Tic Tac Toe) for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Silver Bullet Systems, and published by Brown-Wagh Publishing in 1985.

452215.overview:
It's election season here in the US, and what better way to celebrate than with a presidential election game from the 80s, revamped and nearly entirely re-coded for your entertainment! Play with up to 4 friends to get your candidate to the White House! 
 
...CAMPAIGN MANAGER was a type-in game that my dad played -- specifically, from COMPUTE! magazine -- and when I played the original, I was enthusiastic about the concept but not particularly impressed with the quality. I started with an assembly hack: fixing some bugs, adding more players, and eventually I mapped out and re-coded the entire program. Adding 4-player support, debates, events, sound, custom candidates and maps, a much more realistic way of representing votes, the whole nine yards.

452662.overview:
Color Water Sort Basic (also known as Heustack Clone) is extactly that, a clone of the C64 game Huestack (which was also released in 2024), but done entirely in BASIC.

It was developed by Steveboy for the scene group Blazon, and released into the public domain on August 9, 2024.

453602.overview: C-Sharp is a musical themed pinball game/table developed with the Pinball Construction Set by Charles M. Duncan. It was published in 1990 in PCS Club Disk #22,

454543.overview: Cheeseburger for the Commodore 64, as you probably may guess, is a clone of BurgerTime. It was developed by Krystian Grzenkowicz and released into the public domain in 1990.

454888.overview:
An unreleased playable demo made by Arlasoft in 2022.

The game was to be a conversion of the arcade game of the same name.

454943.overview:
Psytronik Software presents yet another awesome C64 release from master game designer ALF YNGVE.  CAPTAIN ISHTAR VS. THE FEDERATION'S MOST WANTED is Alf's biggest and most ambitious C64 release yet! The game is split into five separate parts and also features separate animated intro and end sequences.

In the far future, the Federation of Planets needs brave space pilots to patrol the spaceways of the Galaxy. Among these interstellar peacekeepers, few are as brave as Captain Ishtar of Mars.

The Federation of Planets has appointed her Star Marshal, with the mission to hunt down these wanted interstellar criminals:

- Zartharn: A terrorist commanding his own army of robots to attack the city planet Magnar.

- The Cozzi Clone Gang: A gang of identical clones that plunders and extorts "protection money" from the mining planet Fromachis-3.

- Nemor: A mysterious shapeshifting con artist and swindler, last spotted on the trading planet Basarre.

In the words of Captain Ishtar: "Wish me luck!"

455168.overview: Classic Bat'n'Ball Tennis is a 2 player only Pong clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Jonathan Wells and released into the public domain in 1998.

455639.overview: This is an emulator of Atari's classic arcade game "Centipede" from 1981 running on the Commodore 64.

455714.overview:
Chopper Rescue is a 1991 public domain game developed by Howard Campbell and published in Stonysoft #1912.

Rescue the skydivers before they die.

455948.overview:
This is a game for 1 or 2 players.

Use a joystick in either port to select the in game options on the title screen, then go to the "Start game" option and then press fire to commence play.

The object of this game is to fight against your opponent. You can use left or right on your joystick to move your tank the proposed direction. Pressing fire will shoot your weapon. If the weapon hits the enemy tank (or vice versa) the power energy counter("POW") will reduce. After the energy counter is empty, one more shot will kill the opponent (your perhaps you). After a tank is destroyed, the player (or computer) that destroys the enemy will score 1 win point. The overall winner is declared after the maximum number of win points has been reached. Collect power ups delivered by the drone, to enhance your firepower or for temporary speed / freeze opponent features. However, avoid the CYAN power up otherwise your tank will be frozen, and the opponent cannot resist battering you down :)

456143.overview:
To put this game in one sentence would be "Run for your life or die!".

Use the joystick to control the player and run from the enemy. You can kill the enemy by dropping a bomb (hold the fire button until the bomb drops). Bombs have timers and will last only a few seconds before they disappear so better aim well and in close range of the enemy. Good luck!

456260.overview: C=64 Copycat is an adaptation of the classic memory game SIMON, originally created by Ralph Baer and Howard J. Morrison and distributed in 1978 by Milton Bradley (MB).

456373.overview: In the 22nd century, an evil cult led by a mysterious force has infiltrated the world government, and with a mixture of terror and cybernetic control has enslaved all nations. A resistance movement has emerged, but has only been able to train two operatives - twin sisters Nadia and Mariska - in the use of a new anti-cyborg vibro-sword weapon. Though vastly outnumbered, these agents must fight their way out of the global capital, through a defence base in the Arctic wasteland, down a tunnel that cuts right through the infrastructure of the enemy's cyber control systems, and thus trace their way to the true centre of the enemy's power and discover its true nature (before slaughtering it good and proper, of course

456395.overview: Can-MaP is a simple Pac-Man clone for the C64. It was developed by Fredric Blåholtz as an entry into the 2015 BASIC 10liner Contest.

456432.overview:
An overhead racing game for 1-2 players developed by Fox/K Design using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit.

It was released in 1989.

456433.overview:
A commercially sold SEUCK game from Champion Software.

Has up to 2 players playing co-op.

456439.overview:
Chopterhunt is a 1-2 player cooperative helicopter based vertically scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64.

The game was developed by Ermig Productions and released into the public domain in 1994.

456455.overview:
Crillion Construction Set is an OFFICIAL level editor/game designer developed by the developer of the original Crillion, Oliver Kirwa

It was published in the following...

•  Happy Computer 1988/08
•  64'er Sonderheft 37, 64'er 
•  Sonderheft 53, 64'er 1999/08

456508.overview:
A clone of games like Atari Circus and Clowns for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Patrick Parrish and published in COMPUTE! 1984/02 (Issue #45) as well as 75 Spill Datatronic.

456552.overview: Cribbage Solitaire is an implementation of the popular solitaire variant for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Christakis Nikou Constantinou and released in 1985 as part of Loadstar #016.

456563.overview:
The Second game in Alf Yngve's Cops series.

as with the other games in the series, it was made with the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit. It was released in 1995.

456639.overview: An astronomy themed quiz game from the book "40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64" / Home Computing Weekly #053 (13.03.1984)

456852.overview: Forget everything you know about Tetris. Cursed Tetris for the C64 is not just a game — it’s an experience designed to test your patience, curiosity, and perhaps even your sense of reality.

457915.overview: Candy-Cat is a simple collect-em-up game for the Commodore 64. The game was developed by Yerrel S. Kasmin and published in Commodore Info 1989/#02.

457933.overview: This is a conversion of a PET game. I have added instructions and  bugswatted the original game.

458337.overview:
Carnival is a pinball game for the Commodore 64 made with the Pinball Construction Kit.

It was developed by Bloodsong and released on PCS Club Disk #24 in 1991.

458513.overview:
Cube Slinker is a Q*Bert clone for the Commodore 64.

It was published in Gold Disk Vol.08 (July 1985) , however the actual developer is unknown.

460030.overview:
Color Scoit, or just simply Scoit, is a brain/puzzle game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Paravision Company and published in Compute mit 1988/04.

460532.overview: The player's task is to reach the exit within a specified time, while avoiding collisions with hostile creatures and all elements of the board. The game is very slow and cannot be completed due to a critical error in the programme code.

460768.overview:
Caprica Defense is a space shooter game for the Commodore 64.
The plot is based on the series Battlestar Galactica and revolves around the Cylon attack on the planet Caprica and the human colonies. The game is very similar to Super Nova, but much more evolved.

460905.overview: A game where you play as a cat just walking through the city streets looking for adventure, interacting with the locals, getting into situations and just trying to find his way home.

461088.overview:
Mordred, an evil wizard, has stolen the Great Cup of Caslalia, plunging all the land into darkness. You have learned that the cup is hidden in a great underground castle. To recover the cup, you must make your way through many caves and caverns leading to the castle. The journey will be difficult; the caves are filled with goblins and traps. Can you return the cup and restore order to the world? 
 
Published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1991/05, which was an insert in the standard Compute! magazine at the time.

461089.overview: Casanova is a German language 1-2 player cooperative run and gun developed by Rainer Dohren & Frank Wankum using Chris Yates' SEUCK engine, and released into the public domain in 1988.

461112.overview: Cloak of Darkness (originally made by Roger Firth) is like a Hello World project for an Interactive Fiction engine. It's a classic (really) short story, realized by hundred of developers using several different languages.

461123.overview: A SEUCK shooter developed by Champion Software (aka Wil Smith) and released in 1992.

462471.overview: During your research into sunken galleons and lost treasures, you found a reference to the location of a pirate ship that had sunk off the coast of a small Caribbean island. With this knowledge, you rented a small yacht and sailed to the location during your summer vacation. You moored the yacht in a tranquil bay and started out by exploring the south coast of the island.

462476.overview: Atari 2600 Video Chess ported to VIC 20 and C-64

462968.overview: CBM-64 Unscramble is a 1K text based Mastermind variant for the C64. It was developed and released by Cout Games on December 24, 2017.

463454.overview:
Heavily inspired by the 1980 classic, "Adventure", Crown Quest is an action/puzzler that was published as a type-in game in the December, 1990 issue of COMPUTE! magazine. 

Put on your armor and sharpen your sword! The black knight has stolen the king's crown, and it's up to you to get it back. It won't be easy. To solve this intricate puzzle, you must find your way through six castles, 16 rooms, and more than 50 maze screens.

463644.overview: Simulates a car race circuit or track. Try to stay on the track the longest. Published in the Italian book "20 Programmi per Commodore 64".

464296.overview: Road to the World Cup is a ritualized football experience for the Commodore 64, where every play is a narrative decision. It's not just about winning: it's about advancing, resisting, and celebrating every moment as part of a living archive.

464304.overview: In Carcer your goal is to escape the dungeons, but there's a catch...each step you take, you need to drop a coin behind you. You can't move with zero coins but you can always go back and pick up the coins you have dropped.

464802.overview: A single player scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by TLS Software using the Shoot "Em Up Construction Kit in 1991.

464927.overview: Cyborgrid is a public domain 2-player only Tron light cycles clone/variant for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Bernd Lietzow in 2018.

465168.overview: Cimbo is a Peg Solitaire variant for the C64. It was developed by Krisztián Tóth and released on September 7, 2019.

465170.overview: CubeSim64 is a computerized Rubik's Cube game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Jazzthief81 in 2019.

465217.overview: Manage roaches. Make money. Don't die.

466895.overview: "Vault of Seraphim" is the new jump & run cave crawler like his predecessor  "Catacombs of Cherubim"!

466900.overview:
Cloco the Robot is a 1-player game in which you must guide Cloco through the factory figting against enemy robot rejects.

The game was developed with the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit and released by TND in 2016.

467502.overview:
Virgin released a Computer Christmas Card that, as the cover states, included a free shooter called Ambush.

Ambush is played on a single screen with no scrolling. You can move your vessel all over the screen, shooting at enemies or avoiding collision with them. Enemies enter the screen from the top and move at various directions and speeds toward the bottom (they bounce and change direction when hitting the left or right side of the screen). When hitting one of them they split into smaller ones, which may have a changed direction and movement speed (this is repeated for the first and sometimes for the second hit).

469156.overview: Count and Add is a title in a series of educational games from Scetlander, dedicated to children aged 5 to 12 years

469293.overview: Clay Pigeon Shoot is a single player clay pigeon target shooting game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published into the public domain by David Kinder in 1987.

469447.overview: Chopper Marauder is a freeware side scrolling shoot 'em up for the Commodore 64. It was developed by someone calling himself King Arthur III and released as part of Digital Marketing PD #103.

469451.overview: Camel Trophy 2 is a one-player only SEUCK shooter developed by Gaetano Chiummo and published by Sea Software in 1990.

469486.overview: Winter is coming, and before the snow falls heavily, our two squirrels need to stock up on chestnuts! Jump on the 3 branches of the tree and don't miss a single chestnut! Watch out for all the dangers and have fun.

469789.overview:
An unreleased caveman themed platfform game similar in some ways t9 Bomb Jack for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by David Bradley and Dean Hickingbottom in 1992.

The game includes a built-in level editor as well.

469794.overview: Curse of the Pharaoh is a classic-style action game set in a haunting ancient tomb.

470613.overview: A modern city-building game for the Commodore 64, written entirely in 6510 Assembly using the CA65 / LD65 toolchain.

470784.overview: Chrome Horizon is a prototype of high-performance shoot 'em up developed as the flagship project for the upcoming book: "Modern Code, Classic Steel: Engineering Professional Action Games for the C64".

471036.overview:
Connect is a 1-2 player computerized version of Connect 4 for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Alpha Software in 1986.

Released as part of 75 Spill Datatronic.

471450.overview:
Crystian is an ordinary boy who never cared much for stones. Everything changed, however, during an expedition with his uncle George, a renowned geologist. Deep within the mines, Crystian excitedly discovered his first shimmering "crystals." His uncle saw immediately that they were just common pieces of rock, but not wanting to ruin the moment, he let the boy believe he had found a treasure. To Crystian, those stones meant everything — a living memory  of the bond shared with his uncle.

Then came the apocalypse. A massive storm and earth tremors unleashed hell underground. Torrents of water flooded the tunnels, hot lava began to rise to the surface, and terrified animals turned wild. In the chaos, Crystian`s collection was scattered to the furthest reaches of the mines.

In an effort to protect his nephew, Uncle George was injured. Though he is safe now, his legs can no longer carry him deeper into the mines. Crystian faces a difficult choice. He knows these stones have no value to anyone else, but to him, they are a piece of his soul. 

Will Crystian remain just an ordinary boy, or will he find the strength of a hero and return for his lost almost-crystals?  The adventure is just beginning...

471871.overview: Curse of the Vampire (also known as Vampire's Curse) is a public domain horror themed text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Noltisoft in 2021.

472221.overview: Cerbos is a 1-4 player German-language board game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by and released into the public domain by OM-Software (Oliver Möller) in 1987.

472889.overview: Play the famous 80's cube puzzle on your Commodore 64.

472896.overview: Press the space bar to start the game and jump over obstacles.

472957.overview: Cocytus Ruins: Ph'nglui Mglw'nafh is a role-playing and dungeon crawler game (Roguelike) developed natively for the legendary Commodore 64

473587.overview: Inspired by Souls-like design, the game encourages a slower, more methodical approach — where observation, timing, and decision-making matter more than reflex alone.

474147.overview: In USC: Counterforce players are tasked with leading a group of Space Commandos in turn-based squad tactics combat inspired by the likes of UFO/XCOM, Space Hulk, and Aliens. The players’ commandos have been sent to a planetary body to investigate and take down a powerful alien threat. Players must discover the truth behind the demise of the planet’s colony and plan an efficient strategy to protect humanity from this threat. They will have the opportunity to fend off aliens with their friends thanks to a local co-op mode (Hot-seat or using Remote Play together).

474411.overview: Cyber-Run is a cyberpunk role-playing and dungeon crawler game (Roguelike) developed natively for the legendary Commodore 64. The year is 2085. You will infiltrate the analog bunker 'Black-Ice', an isolated underground facility where rogue AIs and corporate secrets from Arasaka are hidden from the net.

474568.overview:
Too old to keep up with fast shooters? Too bored to replay the same type of reskinned flip screen platformer over and over again? Can’t be bothered to read a six page manual? Too AI degraded to solve puzzle games or struck down by tendonitis by jerking your joystick too hard.

Comchinko may be just the right game for you.  Just push a button to let your balls drop and see chaos ensue and numbers go up – or just sit there and see the balls drop all by themselves if even this is to much bother.

476094.overview: A humble homebrew shooter for your Commodore 64.

476244.overview: The classic four-castle showdown, rebuilt from scratch in pure 6502 machine code. Defend your fortress. Demolish everyone else's.

476246.overview: Let's be honest: there is still no epic plot here. This remains a simple, unpretentious homebrew game made to hop into a ship, pull the trigger, and turn flying geometric blocks into space dust. However, in this Reloaded edition, we squashed some pesky bugs, smoothed out the performance, and made sure the music bumps at the right tempo. No complex mechanics, just straightforward retro shooting that actually works how it was supposed to from the beginning.

476654.overview: This game is an adaptation of the Italian adventure Morgan Tyler: Il Pianeta Maledetto by Bonaventura Di Bello. It was originally written using The Quill and Illustrator and published by Edizioni Hobby S.r.l. on the cover tape of Viking, no. 2, February 1987 for the ZX Spectrum and Commodore 64.

476831.overview: C64 CRAZY ONE is a fast-paced card game developed natively in 100% Assembly for the legendary Commodore 64. Enjoy the classic color-and-number matching mechanics where you compete against up to three AI opponents in a desperate race to empty your hand.

478090.overview: A Commodore 64 game about redemption, touching grass, and liberating the blue-light zombies from the iron grip of the feed. You'll meet innocents trapped in the algorithm and rage-baited loyalists sent to derail your mission.

479005.overview: A Sudoku game for the Commodore 64, written in C64 BASIC V2.

480076.overview: Remember the Johnny Castaway screensaver for Windows? You could stare for hours at that little guy stranded on his island, watching him go about his day.

480259.overview: cyber-mole is a 48-room, single-screen PAL arcade puzzle

480466.overview: A variant of of the popular online "5-letter word" guessing game, for the C64. It was important to have the entire "official" word dictionary, including both actual valid words, and additional non-words or variations that can be entered as guesses. Only words in this dictionary are valid guesses.

480490.overview: A circuit mapping game for the Commodore 64 written in C64 BASIC

480508.overview: A port of µCity — the city builder for the Game Boy Color by Antonio Niño Díaz — to the Commodore 64, written in 6502 assembly with Kick Assembler.

480743.overview: A Minesweeper clone for the Commodore 64, written in C64 BASIC V2

480747.overview: Navigate the dangers of your local coffee shop as they gather an increasing number of feral cats in the shop! The cats gain speed as you go, making getting your cup of joe more and more fraught!

480748.overview: I made my own version. Back to the game, you have to eat all the goldfish, be careful not to run out of air, if you don’t get them all and move to the right to change the scene, you lose a life. ...

480983.overview:
Cloverhunt is a simple collecting game for the Commodore 64, coded entirely in BASIC by Red Mill, and published by Binary Zone's public domain label. 

The year of release is not currently known.

The player controls a round circle/ball with a small hole in the center and must avoid all the computer controlled circles (which are solid with no hole), and collect all the "clovers", which are represented by The C64 petscii spade smybol.

481075.overview: C64 Tennis is an unofficial fan port of Tennis, Nintendo's 1989 Game Boy game. It's not a remake: the original Game Boy game code was translated instruction by instruction into 6502 assembly. Ball physics, player movement, the CPU opponent and the scoring rules all behave like the original. An automated test compared the C64 version with the real Game Boy game, step by step, over thousands of game updates: they matched exactly.

481555.overview:
Cats 'n' Dogs is a 1-2 player puzzle/board game for the Commodore 64. The game is essentially a take on Tic-Tac-Tie/Nought and Crosses, except instead of X's and O's, you have...well cats and dogs. There is also another difference between this and standard Tic-Tac-Toe, and that you must get 4 in a row instead of 3. So it's basically a cross between Tic-Tac-Toe, and Connect 4.

The game was developed by Fred Karg and Included in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1988/01 (Issue #55).

481585.overview: The player controls an electric snake whose battery is constantly running out. To survive, you must collect lightning bolts that appear in random locations; these partially replenish the battery’s charge and increase the snake’s length. From time to time, a large lightning bolt appears, and collecting it may cause the battery to become temporarily overcharged. Whilst overcharged, the snake is invincible and can eliminate dangerous sparks, destroy walls, collide with its own tail and pass through the outer barrier of the board. Collecting 10 lightning bolts takes the player to the next level, which features a different wall layout and a faster snake movement speed.

481817.overview: A free Commodore 64 Ultimate game in which a cat is the great savior.Every night when the full moon rises over the old graveyard,four naughty ghost mice come out to play. They dig tunnelsunder the gravestones, scare the villagers and steal thetreasure of the old chapel.

481820.overview: COCYTUS LEGIONS is a Lovecraftian Autobattler developed natively in 100% pure 6502 Assembly for the legendary Commodore 64. Assume the role of an occult summoner bound to a rival cultist in a duel of madness and blood. Sacrifice your vital essence at the profane Altar, assemble your legion of cosmic horrors, trigger eldritch synergies, and shatter your opponent's Sanity before your own mind succumbs to the eternal void!

482076.overview:
Original VIC-20 game (c) 1983 Paul Hope / Micro-Antics
C64 release 2026 by TREX - dedicated to the memory of Paul Hope (1949?-2011)

482078.overview: Game is pretty much a little more complicated Towers of Hanoi with Colours

482278.overview: This is a short tiny game i had in the back of my mind months ago, created in a spare few hours, it was to be something along the lines off. The most annoying flappy game ever made.

482612.overview: Explore mysterious caverns filled with dangers, enemies, and challenges as you progress through action-packed levels. Jump between platforms, dodge prehistoric creatures, face increasingly difficult enemies, and collect items to unlock the path to the next adventure.

482749.overview: This is a platformer game called the The Collector.  You play as an adventurer, named Ian Johns, who decides to explore in search of treasure inside a mysterious mine, and castle, which he uncovers deep in the woods somewhere in eastern Europe. The goal is to avoid the enemies, collect all the crystals and gold, and find the exit within all 12 levels of the game.

482780.overview: Take control of a powerful Cobra attack helicopter and battle your way through 12 underground levels. Dodge rocks, destroy enemy defenses and survive dangerous tunnels. Eight easy levels, three medium levels and one challenging final mission!

482781.overview: Take control of your Cobra helicopter and destroy enemy submarines across 12 challenging levels. Drop depth charges, fire missiles and survive enemy attacks. Can you defeat the mighty Leviathan?

482835.overview: The manor witch has kidnapped the cats and is keeping them locked away in her haunted rooms. You are the only one who can bring them back home: room after room, you navigate the manor, pick up a cat, and carry it to safety. But ghosts and bats have no intention of letting you pass, and every three rooms, the witch herself comes out to hunt you down.

482846.overview:
Castle is a single-screen platform game for the Commodore 64 in which you play a little green character with a rather large nose.

The game was developed by Arttu Suihkonen and published by Protocol Productions in Floppy Magazine 1986/3,

482956.overview: You are a cat! A black cat with white socks.You live in a cosy room with a grey cat. There is a ball of yarn, a sofa, a food bowl and an old computer. Run around. Play with the ball. Say hello to the other cat. Eat. Take a nap. Meow!
